description: This file defines the Reward model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling customer reward points management including adding, deleting, and retrieving reward records from the database.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Model class for managing customer reward points in the database.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Creates a new customer reward record in the database with specified points and description.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Deletes reward records for a customer, optionally filtered by order ID.

methods.name: deleteRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward records associated with a specific order ID where points are negative.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Retrieves reward records for a customer with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Returns the total count of reward records for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates the sum of reward points for a customer.
